motivation.interpretation: Preserving the first local proposal did not make the prior policy conservative: repeated second-slot substitutions compounded into nearly universal track churn, the earlier initial-search gain did not replicate, and source-level signs were unstable. A source allowlist or another broad phase boundary is therefore not licensed.

candidate.scope: initial search only; repair and resumed search use the accepted proposer and accepted inference artifact exactly
candidate.default: retain the accepted geometrically distinct first and second proposals
candidate.challenger: the residual-adjusted ordering's highest proposal geometrically distinct from the accepted first proposal
candidate.otherwise: return the complete accepted proposal list byte-for-byte
candidate.first_proposal: always the exact accepted first proposal

implementation.artifact_shape: 48-tree append-only histogram ensemble whose first 32 trees and initial prediction exactly equal the accepted artifact
implementation.inference: one feature extraction and one 48-tree traversal expose the exact accepted 32-tree checkpoint and residual-adjusted completion
implementation.selection: the guarded helper retains the complete incumbent proposal list unless a different residual challenger clears all three inclusive gates
implementation.lane_isolation: residual inference and selection run only in the initial lane; repair and resumed lanes call the accepted 32-tree scorer

offline_lead.adaptivity: The constants were selected after an exploratory threshold scan on the same frozen proxy partition. They are a mechanistic operating point, not independent statistical evidence. The additional production-utility regret guard has no claim from this proxy.

telemetry_contract.availability: always present in ordinary compile stats when the aim lane runs; not hidden behind study-only instrumentation

required: the residual artifact retains the accepted 32-tree model as an exact prefix
the accepted first proposal is preserved for every eligible selection
repair and resumed lanes record bypassed grids and zero substitutions
proposal and exact-evaluation counts remain fixed
at least one guarded substitution occurs in the live mechanism check
the guarded substitution rate is materially below the unrestricted policy
precanonical_contract.not_a_score_gate: Smoke and mechanism checks validate implementation and intervention sparsity only. They do not select on authored score.

full_tests.pre_existing_failure: benchmark_v2_baseline_cache expects the campaign baseline's 799f49... decision-protocol fingerprint, while the current checkpoint-streaming protocol computes 26d6c9...; no candidate file participates in that fingerprint and benchmark status remains comparison-ready

precanonical_verification.candidate_typecheck: no non-import-path errors in the modified runtime or test files with allowImportingTsExtensions enabled
precanonical_verification.contract_result: passed; the guarded intervention is live, sparse, lane-isolated, and fully attributed

decision_protocol.promotion_rule: the governed calibrated directional-probability action only
decision_protocol.on_accept: promote and retain the guarded residual implementation
decision_protocol.otherwise: record the evidence and remove the residual runtime/artifact path cleanly

rare_validity_event.interpretation: This real capability gain dominates the official point estimate and seed-block uncertainty; it does not by itself resolve repeatable headline improvement.

matched_valid_phase_decomposition.interpretation: The guarded policy produced a reproducible-looking gain at the end of initial search, but later work gave back most of it. This is a phase association, not an isolated repair effect: the changed initial path also changes the repair incumbent. The final matched-valid effect remains unresolved.

canonical_gate_telemetry.failure_counter_semantics: independent; one challenger may fail multiple gates
canonical_gate_telemetry.interpretation: The guard reduced substitutions from the prior smoke's 34.4% to 7.9% of eligible pairs canonically while preserving every first choice. The residual-advantage threshold was the dominant rejection mechanism. Raw intervention counts have near-zero descriptive correlation with matched final-score deltas and are confounded by specification length/search activity.

decision.reason: The single predeclared candidate did not meet the governed N48 directional-probability threshold. The positive initial-phase association is a valuable follow-up lead, but does not license promotion or post-hoc gate tuning.
decision.natural_follow_up: Study why changed initial incumbents lose value during later repair/resumed work, then predeclare a policy that preserves proven initial value across that boundary; do not rerun the multi-budget sweep or tune these gate constants on this canonical result.

candidate_removal.scope: residual model artifact, checkpoint inference, guarded pair selection, lane state, always-on candidate telemetry, and candidate-only tests removed
candidate_removal.runtime_restoration: byte-identical to the parent of the candidate implementation commit for every affected accepted-runtime file
